## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/clarifai/chat/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['create a ClarifaiConfig instance to configure OpenAI-compatible chat completions for Clarifai', 'build a transformed request by resolving the base model URL and delegating to the parent OpenAI transformer', 'test the get_base_model method to convert a model string like user_id.app_id.model_id into a Clarifai URL', 'summarize how transform_response parses the HTTP response, logs it, and returns a standard ModelResponse', 'review the get_error_class method to understand how Clarifai errors map to OpenAIError exceptions']
```
